teaser: An agentic console, simulated: accounts as trust zones, time you can rewind, signed messages on three channels, honest stops, and the console as an agent.
core_idea: What makes an agentic brain sellable is a console, a control room for agents. A simulated one, shaped on the Web Summit team, draws ten accounts as trust zones with conductors and agents, shows models, state, commits and signed messages on three channels (repository files, commit messages, vault lanes), replays any moment because the state is files, says when a stop will land, scopes the view per person, and is itself an agent with a key. It follows situation awareness (perceive, understand, project) and control-room design (colour for exceptions).
